write.summary: Writes a json resource into the pack's data/ folder.
write.description: The id is the one commands use, `namespace:folder/name`, and the path follows from it. Only while generating: run `/blossom data generate <app>`, which calls the app's `generate()`.
params: a map, written out as json

write_text.summary: Writes a resource that is not json — a .mcfunction, say.
write_text.description: The id carries the extension, because nothing else says what kind of file it is.
params: a list of lines, or a single string
